text:
Maya CSM: quick sync after today's HarborFlow private deploy smoke tests. found a few infra gaps — MTU/BGP + KMS grant + trail forwarding. short notes below.
Dan Eng: send the failures you saw?
Maya CSM: main issue: control-plane connections intermittently drop during large payload uploads. tcpdump shows fragmentation/ICMP frag-needed.
Liam (HarborFlow): we've got jumbo frames (mtu 9000) on our edge routers and the transit peers.
Dan Eng: Redwood CNI defaults to 1500. two options: set pod/net MTU to 9000 (if all hops support) or enable MSS clamping on the edge. which is easier for you?
Liam (HarborFlow): ops prefers not to change cluster CNI today. we'll enable MSS clamp on the edge firewall. ETA 2h.
Priya Sec: KMS: noticed the service role used by redwood-priv doesn't have a Grant or key policy statement for cross-account usage. Encrypt calls failing in logs.
Liam (HarborFlow): we saw `AccessDeniedException` around Encrypt during load tests.
Priya Sec: add this to the key policy / grant for the CMK: 
Priya Sec: ```json
{
  "Sid": "AllowRedwoodService",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::999888777666:role/redwood-priv-role"},
  "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```
Priya Sec: or create a Grant from the CMK to the service principal. confirm when done.
Sarah CE: audit logs: CloudTrail multi-account trail exists but the subscription for control-plane event patterns wasn't matching because `eventSource` filter used wrong service name. missing `redwood.amazonaws.com` mapping for some events.
Dan Eng: can you paste the CLI you used?
Sarah CE: `aws logs put-subscription-filter --log-group-name /redwood/harborflow/controlplane --filter-name cp-forward --filter-pattern '{($.eventSource = "redwood.amazonaws.com") || ($.detail-type = "AWS API Call via CloudTrail")}' --destination-arn arn:aws:logs:us-east-1:123456789012:destination:splunk-harborflow`
Sarah CE: updated pattern to also include `aws.redwood` and restarted forwarding; monitoring for drops.
Maya CSM: FYI flagging this as a medium renewal risk until control-plane logs are stable and KMS grants are validated. onboarding delayed by ~1 day. not critical but log it for renewals.
Liam (HarborFlow): noted on our side. key policy updated, MSS clamp in place, will run end-to-end test and post results.
Dan Eng: once logs + KMS pass, we'll run a short failover test (route to backup region) and confirm latency/SLO.
Maya CSM: scheduling enablement deep-dive Thurs 9am PT to walk through runbook + cost controls + BGP hints. Sarah to send invite?
Sarah CE: invite sent, included a short pre-read and sample Splunk mappings (fields->index examples).
Liam (HarborFlow): quick feedback on docs: sample mapping is great, would love a concrete example for `redwood.request_id -> splunk.request_id` + timestamp parsing.
Dan Eng: I'll add that snippet to the runbook today.
deploy-bot: Deployment 1711112223 completed for harborflow-priv (green) :white_check_mark:
Maya CSM: action items recap: 1) HarborFlow ops -> confirm MSS clamp pass & share tcpdump. 2) HarborFlow sec -> confirm CMK grant applied. 3) Sarah -> validate control-plane forwarding for 24h. 4) Dan -> add Splunk mapping snippet to runbook.
Liam (HarborFlow): will update in 2h and ping channel.
Maya CSM: thanks everyone, moving to post-cutover health window. ping for followups.
